images.prompt: Cinematic wide establishing shot of a bright pink-and-orange donut shop counter at 6am. Above the counter hangs one enormous menu board that is a completely blank flat magenta panel with an orange frame: absolutely no writing, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no squiggles or scribbles on it or anywhere else in the room.
